svg.title: Four layers between card SQL and a published dashboard
svg.desc: Card SQL is parsed without running and must be one SELECT with no table functions. Its tables are checked against the caller's role scope. It runs on a read-only copy of gold holding only those tables, with a time limit and a row cap. Before publishing, every card must work for every audience role, and published dashboards are re-checked after each data run.
svg.text: Self-serve only works when the boundary is enforced in code
The same checks apply whether the SQL came from a person, their agent or a built-in page.

g.text: Exactly one SELECT. No table functions, no file reads. Length limit.
Every table it reads must belong to the caller's roles.
A read-only copy holding only those tables, a time limit and a row cap.
Every card works for every audience role, and again after each run.
